summary: Iteration 4: Verified the revision-dedup + inactive-item-skip bug fix in sap_soap_client.py. Updated backend_test.py with new expected counts (FLT2_4.1=91/5, 8060522_1=23/2) and re-ran full pytest suite - ALL 8 tests PASS in ~28s. Playwright E2E on public URL confirmed the exact same numbers end-to-end: FLT2_4.1 -> 91 rows, Total Components=91, Max Level=5, Active Materials=91, all 91 rows show green 'Yes' active badge (0 'No' badges), 18 rows show '▾' sub-BOM marker (has_sub_bom); 8060522_1 -> 23 rows with expected CLS310207HW-* product IDs; INVALID_BOM_999 shows bom-search-error-alert with 'BOM INVALID_BOM_999 not found in SAP'; SAP Connected indicator green on page load; loading skeleton observed during FLT2_4.1 recursive SOAP call. Toast notification 'BOM FLT2_4.1 loaded - 91 components across 5 levels' also shown. No console errors from the app.
critical_code_review_comments: Prior iteration_3 note still open: _safe_fetch_by_output_product silently swallows SAP ConnectTimeout/ReadTimeout with no retry; on a slow SAP day a subtree can silently drop. Consider bounded retry with backoff and/or a 'partial_results' flag in BomSearchResponse. Not observed in this iteration (all runs stable).
sap_client.py (old OData module) still in repo and unused - safe to delete.
test_credentials: N/A (no app auth). SAP SOAP creds in backend/.env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix VERIFIED end-to-end.
